plugins.name: grand-to-ground
plugins.description: Adversarial, Lakatos-inspired research loop for AI-assisted social science, now in two modes: the research cycle (parallel deduction, a three-critic tribunal with a severity dial, tick-to-approve research plans) and the new Theory Forge (propositions checked one by one at a cold-start verification gate, entered into a proposition graph with cascade revocation) — both started by one line, "run G2G", and bounded, when run unattended, by a token budget.
